text:
Liam (Sales): Quick handoff for Varuna Labs — agreed enterprise contract signed + 12mo reserved Dedicated. Key asks below, pinging CS for next steps.

Liam (Sales): Account health: high intent, PoC passed, legal complete. Renewal risk low if onboarding finishes in 30 days.

Liam (Sales): Onboarding status: provisioning in progress (cloud reqs done), customer needs SSO, VPC peering, and a private model mount for PHI evals.

Liam (Sales): Open technical asks: 1) SSO via Okta (SCIM + SAML), 2) VPC peering + subnet ranges, 3) dedicated GPU pool sizing for 4 rps peak, 4) data egress/KMS FAQ for compliance.

Priya (CS): Thanks — I'll own the onboarding runway. Assigned: Priya leads onboarding, Maya to run enablement docs, Sam for triage/support after go-live, Aisha for infra handoffs.

Priya (CS): Can someone confirm SLA for Dedicated capacity warm-up? customer expects <200ms p95 for 512-token gen after warmup.

Aisha (Eng): Eng note: warm-up depends on model variant. For rtx-a40 pool we usually see ~180–220ms p95 at 512 tokens with continuous batching enabled. We'll add autoscale policy: min rep 2, burst +1.

Sam (Support): I'll prep runbooks for first 30 days. Need contact for customer's infra team and expected traffic windows.

Maya (CS PM): I'll build a 1-pager enablement checklist for AMs + their engineers: includes SSO steps, test prompts, eval set, and rollback triggers. Will post draft by EOD tomorrow.

Devin (Solutions Eng): Sharing a minimal curl sample customers can use to smoke test once SSO/VPC done:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-dedicated","input":"hello"}'
```
Devin (Solutions Eng): Also adding a small prompt set for latency/quality smoke: 5 short, 5 long, 2 few-shot. I'll upload to the shared folder.

Liam (Sales): Customer contact: devops@varunalabs.com (Asha Singh). They prefer weekday peering windows 0200-0600 UTC.

Priya (CS): Action items:
- Priya: schedule kickoff + 3/weekly checkpoints (owner)
- Aisha: validate VPC peering config + subnet allowlist (owner)
- Devin: drop smoke tests + QA prompt set into /shared/varuna (owner)
- Sam: create support-runbook template and oncall rotation for first 30d (owner)
- Maya: deliver enablement 1-pager and recording (owner)

Priya (CS): Also capturing renewal risk note: customer has strict PHI requirements — we must surface KMS/HSM integration timeline to procurement. If HSM not available within 45 days, procurement flags could impact renewal negotiation.

Aisha (Eng): Noted — KMS timeline: KMS integration ready in staging next week, HSM roadmap is 6–8 weeks for dedicated tenants. I'll block time with security to prepare a compliance note for procurement.

Sam (Support): I'll create a ticket in our support tracker: VAR-1001 "Varuna onboarding runbook + peering verification" and link it here when created. Will include checklist items and expected owner slack links.

ops-bot: Ticket created VAR-1001 by Sam (Support) — https://support.redwood.ai/VAR-1001

Devin (Solutions Eng): Quick config snippet for Okta SAML ACS URL to share with customer:
- ACS: https://auth.redwood.ai/saml/varuna/acs
- Entity ID: https://auth.redwood.ai/saml/varuna
- SCIM: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/scim/v1/Users

Maya (CS PM): For enablement session, recommend 45 min: 15 min infra, 15 min prompts/quality, 15 min support + runbook walkthrough. Will schedule with Liam and Varuna AM.

Priya (CS): Next sync: kickoff Thurs 14:00 UTC. I'll drop calendar invite and agenda. Please add any pre-kickoff docs into /shared/varuna by EOD Wed.

Liam (Sales): Adding negotiation note: customer requested 10% reduction if SLA not met in first 60d. We'll put that into the contract as a conditional credit; legal ok'd provisional clause. Keep CS informed.

Aisha (Eng): Confirming I will run a quick capacity test on staging tomorrow and post results to thread. Expecting to validate warm-up and KV cache behavior.

Sam (Support): Created initial support doc draft: https://wiki.redwood.ai/varuna-onboarding-runbook — please comment.

Priya (CS): Thanks all. Owners please update VAR-1001 with progress. I'll compile a short risk register before kickoff.

Liam (Sales): Thanks team — will join kickoff and handover notes to Varuna AM. :handshake:

Aisha (Eng): quick follow-up — need the customer's public ASN for peering NAT. Liam, can you get that before EOD?

Liam (Sales): on it, pinging Asha now.

Priya (CS): Closing note: primary success metric = go-live within 30 days with p95 < 250ms and 0 critical incidents in first 2 weeks. Tracking in VAR-1001.

Maya (CS PM): I'll add success metrics to the enablement doc.

Sam (Support): I'll set up alerting on error rate and latency thresholds for first 30 days and link to oncall playbook.

Aisha (Eng): Posted staging capacity results: 220ms p95 @512 tokens, baseline QPS 5 with continuous batching; attaching graphs to VAR-1001.

Priya (CS): Perfect. Great handoff. Will follow up after kickoff with owners’ status.
